About PCSX2: PCSX2 is a free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator. Its purpose is to emulate the PS2's hardware, using a combination of MIPS CPU Interpreters, Recompilers and a Virtual Machine which manages hardware states and PS2 system memory. This allows you to play PS2 games on your PC, with many additional features and benefits.
关于 PCSX2: PCSX2 是一款免费开源的 PlayStation 2（PS2）模拟器。它通过结合 MIPS CPU 解释器、重编译器和虚拟机来模拟 PS2 的硬件，其中虚拟机负责管理硬件状态和 PS2 系统内存。这使得您可以在 PC 上畅玩 PS2 游戏，并享受诸多额外的功能和优势。

About PCSX2: Changes how PCSX2 handles rounding while emulating the Emotion Engine's Floating Point Unit (EE FPU). Because the various FPUs in the PS2 are non-compliant with international standards, some games may need different modes to do math correctly. The default value handles the vast majority of games; modifying this setting when a game is not having a visible problem can cause instability.
关于 PCSX2: 更改 PCSX2 在模拟情感引擎的浮点单元（EE FPU）时处理舍入的方式。由于 PS2 中的各种浮点单元不符合国际标准，一些游戏可能需要不同的模式才能正确地进行数学运算。默认值适用于绝大多数游戏；在游戏没有明显问题时修改此设置可能会导致不稳定。

About PCSX2: Determines how the results of floating-point division are rounded. Some games need specific settings; modifying this setting when a game is not having a visible problem can cause instability.
关于 PCSX2: 确定浮点除法结果的舍入方式。有些游戏需要特定的设置；当游戏没有明显问题时修改此设置可能会导致不稳定。

About PCSX2: Changes how PCSX2 handles keeping floats in a standard x86 range. The default value handles the vast majority of games; modifying this setting when a game is not having a visible problem can cause instability.
关于 PCSX2: 更改 PCSX2 将浮点数处理保持在标准 x86 范围内的方式。默认值适用于绝大多数游戏；在游戏没有明显问题时修改此设置可能会导致不稳定。

About PCSX2: Higher values may increase internal framerate in games, but will increase CPU requirements substantially. Lower values will reduce the CPU load allowing lightweight games to run full speed on weaker CPUs.
关于 PCSX2: 较高的值可能会增加游戏的内部帧速率,但会大幅增加对 CPU 的需求。较低的值将减少 CPU 负载使得轻量级游戏在较差的 CPU 上全速运行。

关于 PCSX2: 使模拟情感引擎跳过循环。有助于类似 SOTC 这样的一小部分游戏。大多数情况下这对性能是有害的。

About PCSX2: Sets the fast-forward speed. This speed will be used when the fast-forward hotkey is pressed/toggled.

关于 PCSX2: 通常在具有 4 个或更多核心的 CPU 上有加速效果。对大多数游戏来说都是安全的,但是也有一些是不兼容的可能会卡死。

About PCSX2: Fast disc access, shorter loading times. Check HDLoader compatibility lists for games that are known to have issues with this.
关于 PCSX2: 快速的光盘访问,更短的加载时间。请检查 HDPlayer 兼容性列表来了解存在已知问题的游戏。

About PCSX2: Loads the disc image into RAM before starting the virtual machine. Can reduce stutter on systems with hard drives that have long wake times, but significantly increases boot times.
关于 PCSX2: 在启动虚拟机之前将光盘映像加载到内存中。可以减少具有较长唤醒时间的硬盘系统上的卡顿,但会显著增加启动时间。

About PCSX2: Sets the VSync queue size to 0, making every frame be completed and presented by the GS before input is polled and the next frame begins. Using this setting can reduce input lag at the cost of measurably higher CPU and GPU requirements.
关于 PCSX2: 将垂直同步队列大小设置为 0,使每一帧在轮询输入并开始下一帧之前由 GS 完成并呈现。使用此设置可以减少输入延迟但代价是显著提高了 CPU 和 GPU 需求。

About PCSX2: Speeds up emulation so that the guest refresh rate matches the host. This results in the smoothest animations possible, at the cost of potentially increasing the emulation speed by less than 1%. Sync to Host Refresh Rate will not take effect if the console's refresh rate is too far from the host's refresh rate. Users with variable refresh rate displays should disable this option.
关于 PCSX2: 加快模拟速度使来客户机刷新率与主机匹配。这会产生尽可能最流畅的动画,但可能会将模拟速度提高不到 1%。如果控制台的刷新率与主机的刷新率相差太远则同步到主机刷新率将不会生效。具有可变刷新率显示器的用户应禁用此选项。

About PCSX2: Uses the operating system's date/time format rather than "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss". May exclude seconds.
关于 PCSX2: 使用操作系统的日期/时间格式，而不是 "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"。可以不包括秒数。

About PCSX2: Sets the maximum number of frames that can be queued up to the GS, before the CPU thread will wait for one of them to complete before continuing. Higher values can assist with smoothing out irregular frame times, but increase input lag.

About PCSX2: PCSX2 is a free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator. Its purpose is to emulate the PS2's hardware, using a combination of MIPS CPU Interpreters, Recompilers and a Virtual Machine which manages hardware states and PS2 system memory. This allows you to play PS2 games on your PC, with many additional features and benefits.

About PCSX2:
Changes what filtering algorithm is used to map textures to surfaces.
Nearest: Makes no attempt to blend colors.
Bilinear (Forced): Will blend colors together to remove harsh edges between different colored pixels even if the game told the PS2 not to.
Bilinear (PS2): Will apply filtering to all surfaces that a game instructs the PS2 to filter.
Bilinear (Forced Excluding Sprites): Will apply filtering to all surfaces, even if the game told the PS2 not to, except sprites.
关于 PCSX2:
更改用于将纹理映射到表面的过滤算法。
最接近的: 不尝试混合颜色。
双线性 (强制): 即使游戏告诉 PS2 不要这样做,也会将颜色混合在一起,以去除不同颜色像素之间的粗糙边缘。
双线性 (PS2): 将过滤应用于游戏指示 PS2 过滤的所有表面。
双线性 (强制排除活动块): 将对所有表面应用过滤,即使游戏告诉 PS2 不要这样做,活动块除外。

About PCSX2:
Reduces blurriness of large textures applied to small, steeply angled surfaces by sampling colors from the two nearest Mipmaps. Requires Mipmapping to be 'on'.
Off: Disables the feature.
Trilinear (PS2): Applies Trilinear filtering to all surfaces that a game instructs the PS2 to.
Trilinear (Forced): Applies Trilinear filtering to all surfaces, even if the game told the PS2 not to.
关于 PCSX2:
通过从两个最近的 mipmap 贴图中采样颜色,减少应用于小而陡角度表面的大型纹理的模糊度。要求纹理贴图处于 “打开” 状态。
关闭: 禁用该功能。
三线性(PS2): 对游戏指示 PS2 进行的所有表面进行三线性过滤。
三线性(强制): 对所有表面进行三线性过滤,即使游戏告诉 PS2 不要这样做。

替代驱动程序的规则以启用独占全屏或直接翻转/扫描。
禁用独占全屏可能会使得认为切换以及覆盖更加流畅,但会增加输入延迟。

About PCSX2: Enables Rasterizer Ordered View (ROV), which allows feedback loops to be executed with fewer draw calls. Can improve performance in feedback heavy games with higher accuracy settings.
关于 PCSX2: 启用光栅化器顺序视图(ROV),允许用更少的绘制调用执行反馈循环。在反馈密集型游戏中使用较高的精度设置时可以提高性能。

About PCSX2: Forces extra barriers when using ROV with Vulkan to fix graphical issues present in some games and hardware configurations.
关于 PCSX2: 在使用 ROV 和 Vulkan 时强制使用额外的屏障,以修复某些游戏和硬件配置中存在的图形问题。

About PCSX2: Displays additional, very high upscaling multipliers dependent on GPU and driver capability.
关于 PCSX2: 显示取决于 GPU 和驱动程序能力的额外非常高的放大倍数。

About PCSX2: Forces SW blending and disables several optimizations.
关于 PCSX2: 强制使用 SW 混合并且禁用数个优化。

About PCSX2: Determines what frame rate NTSC games run at.
关于 PCSX2: 确定 NTSC 游戏运行的帧率。

About PCSX2: Determines what frame rate PAL games run at.
关于 PCSX2: 确定 PAL 游戏运行的帧率。

About PCSX2: Adds padding to the display area to ensure that the ratio between pixels on the host to pixels in the console is an integer number. May result in a sharper image in some 2D games.
关于 PCSX2: 填充显示区域以确保主机上的像素与游戏机中的像素之间的比率为整数。可能会在一些2D游戏中产生更清晰的图像。

About PCSX2: Determines the deinterlacing method to be used on the interlaced screen of the emulated console. Automatic should be able to correctly deinterlace most games, but if you see visibly shaky graphics, try one of the other options.
关于 PCSX2: 确定在模拟主机的隔行扫描屏幕上使用的去隔行扫描方式。自动应该能够正确地反交错大多数游戏,但如果您看到图形明显晃动,请尝试其他选项。

About PCSX2: Determines the resolution at which screenshots will be saved. Internal resolutions preserve more detail at the cost of file size.
关于 PCSX2: 确定保存屏幕截图的分辨率。内部分辨率以文件大小为代价保留了更多细节。

About PCSX2: Selects the format which will be used to save screenshots. JPEG produces smaller files, but loses detail.
关于 PCSX2: 选择将用于保存屏幕截图的格式。JPEG 会生成较小的文件,但会丢失细节。

About PCSX2: Uploads entire textures at once instead of in small pieces, avoiding redundant uploads when possible. Improves performance in most games, but can make a small selection slower.
关于 PCSX2: 一次上传整个纹理而不是切分成小块,尽可能避免重复上传。提高大多数游戏的性能,但可能导致很小范围内的游戏变慢。

About PCSX2: When enabled the GPU will convert colormap textures, otherwise the CPU will. It is a trade-off between GPU and CPU.
关于 PCSX2: 开启后 GPU 将负责转换色彩纹理贴图,否则由 CPU 转换。这是 GPU 和 CPU 之间的权衡。

About PCSX2: Forces a primitive flush when a framebuffer is also an input texture. Fixes some processing effects such as the shadows in the Jak series and radiosity in GTA:SA.
关于 PCSX2: 当帧缓冲区也是输入纹理时强制进行原始刷新。修复一些诸如 Jak 系列中的阴影和 GTA:SA 中的辐射度等的处理效果。

About PCSX2: Tries to detect when a game is drawing its own color palette and then renders it on the GPU with special handling.
关于 PCSX2: 尝试检测游戏何时绘制自己的调色板然后通过特殊处理将其使用 GPU 进行渲染。

About PCSX2: Disables the support of depth buffers in the texture cache. Will likely create various glitches and is only useful for debugging.
关于 PCSX2: 禁用纹理缓存中深度缓冲的支持。可能会产生各种问题且仅对调试有用。

About PCSX2: This option disables multiple safe features. Disables accurate Unscale Point and Line rendering which can help Xenosaga games. Disables accurate GS Memory Clearing to be done on the CPU, and lets the GPU handle it, which can help Kingdom Hearts games.
关于 PCSX2: 此选项禁用多个安全功能。禁用精确的升格点和线渲染,这有助于改善异度传说系列游戏。禁止在 CPU 上进行准确的 GS 内存清除,并让 GPU 处理它,这有助于改善王国之心系列游戏。

About PCSX2: Stretches (< 100%) or squashes (> 100%) the vertical component of the display.
关于 PCSX2: 拉伸 (< 100%) 或收缩 (> 100%) 显示的垂直部分。

About PCSX2: Chooses the fullscreen resolution and frequency.
关于 PCSX2: 选择全屏分辨率和频率。

About PCSX2: Changes the number of pixels cropped from the left side of the display.
关于 PCSX2: 更改从显示屏左侧裁剪的像素数。

About PCSX2: Changes the number of pixels cropped from the top of the display.
关于 PCSX2: 更改从显示屏顶端裁剪的像素数。

About PCSX2: Changes the number of pixels cropped from the right side of the display.
关于 PCSX2: 更改从显示屏右侧裁剪的像素数。

About PCSX2: Changes the number of pixels cropped from the bottom of the display.
关于 PCSX2: 更改从显示屏底部裁剪的像素数。

About PCSX2:
Control the resolution at which games are rendered. High resolutions can impact performance on older or lower-end GPUs.
Non-native resolution may cause minor graphical issues in some games.
FMV resolution will remain unchanged, as the video files are pre-rendered.
关于 PCSX2:
控制渲染游戏的分辨率。高分辨率可能会影响较旧或较低端 GPU 的性能。
非本机分辨率可能会在某些游戏中导致轻微的图形问题。
FMV分辨率将保持不变,因为视频文件是预先渲染的。

About PCSX2: Reduces texture aliasing at extreme viewing angles.
关于 PCSX2: 减少极端视角下的纹理锯齿。

About PCSX2:
Reduces banding between colors and improves the perceived color depth.
Off: Disables any dithering.
Scaled: Upscaling-aware / Highest dithering effect.
Unscaled: Native dithering / Lowest dithering effect, does not increase size of squares when upscaling.
Force 32bit: Treats all draws as if they were 32bit to avoid banding and dithering.
关于 PCSX2:
减少颜色之间的彩条并提高感知的颜色深度。
关闭: 禁用任何抖动。
缩放:可缩放/最高抖动效果。
不缩放: 原生抖动/最低抖动效果,放大时不会增加方块的大小。
强制 32 位: 将所有描绘视为32 位以避免彩条和抖动。

About PCSX2:
Control the accuracy level of the GS blending unit emulation.
The higher the setting, the more blending is emulated in the shader accurately, and the higher the speed penalty will be.
关于 PCSX2:
控制 GS 混合单元模拟的精确性水平。
设置越高,着色器中准确模拟的混合越多,速度损失也就越高。

About PCSX2: Enabling this option gives you the ability to change the renderer and upscaling fixes to your games. However IF you have ENABLED this, you WILL DISABLE AUTOMATIC SETTINGS and you can re-enable automatic settings by unchecking this option.
关于 PCSX2: 启用此选项后您可以更改渲染器并升级游戏的修复。但是如果您已启用此选项,您将禁用自动设置并可以通过取消选中此选项来重新启用自动设置。

About PCSX2: Enables mipmapping, which some games require to render correctly.
关于 PCSX2: 启用 mipmap 贴图,某些游戏需要它才能正确渲染。

About PCSX2: The maximum target memory width that will allow the CPU Sprite Renderer to activate on.
关于 PCSX2: 允许 CPU 活动块渲染器上激活的最大目标内存宽度。

About PCSX2: Tries to detect when a game is drawing its own color palette and then renders it in software, instead of on the GPU.
关于 PCSX2: 尝试检测游戏何时绘制自己的调色板然后在软件中渲染它,而不是在 GPU 上。

About PCSX2: Completely skips drawing surfaces from the surface in the left box up to the surface specified in the box on the right.
关于 PCSX2: 完全跳过绘制表面,从左侧框中的表面一直到右侧框中指定的表面。

About PCSX2: Uploads GS data when rendering a new frame to reproduce some effects accurately.
关于 PCSX2: 渲染新帧时上载 GS 数据以准确再现某些效果。

About PCSX2: Truncate 32-bit depth values to 24 bits. Helps games struggling with Z-fighting.
关于 PCSX2: 将 32 位深度值截断为 24 位。帮助解决游戏中的深度冲突问题。

About PCSX2: Flushes all targets in the texture cache back to local memory when shutting down. Can prevent lost visuals when saving state or switching graphics APIs, but can also cause graphical corruption.
关于 PCSX2: 关闭时将纹理缓存中的所有目标刷新回本地内存。可以防止即时存档或切换图形 API 时丢失图形效果,但也可能导致图形损坏。

About PCSX2: Might fix some misaligned fog, bloom, or blend effect.
关于 PCSX2: 可能会修复一些未对齐的雾、光晕或混合效果。

About PCSX2: Corrects the sampling of 2D sprite textures when upscaling. Fixes lines in sprites of games like Ar tonelico when upscaling. Half option is for flat sprites, Full is for all sprites.
关于 PCSX2: 修复了缩放时 2D 活动块纹理的采样。修正了类似魔塔大陆等游戏升格时活动块中的线条。半选项适用于扁平活动块,完整选项适用于所有活动块。

About PCSX2: Offset for the ST/UV texture coordinates. Fixes some odd texture issues and might fix some post processing alignment too.
关于 PCSX2: ST/UV纹理坐标的偏移。修复了一些奇怪的纹理问题也可能修复了一些后处理对齐。

About PCSX2: Lowers the GS precision to avoid gaps between pixels when upscaling. Fixes the text on Wild Arms games.
关于 PCSX2: 降低 GS 精度以避免在缩放时像素之间出现间隙。修正了 Wild Arms 游戏中的文字。

About PCSX2: Can smooth out textures due to be bilinear filtered when upscaling. E.g. Brave sun glare.
关于 PCSX2: 由于在缩放时会进行双线性过滤所以可以平滑纹理。

About PCSX2: Replaces post-processing multiple paving sprites by a single fat sprite. It reduces various upscaling lines.
关于 PCSX2: 将后处理的多个铺装活动块替换为单个胖活动块。它减少了各种升格后的线条。

About PCSX2: Enables saturation, contrast, and brightness to be adjusted. Values of brightness, saturation, and contrast are at default 50.
关于 PCSX2: 允许调整饱和度、对比度和亮度。亮度、饱和度和对比度的值默认为 50。

About PCSX2: Applies the FXAA anti-aliasing algorithm to improve the visual quality of games.
关于 PCSX2: 应用 FXAA 抗锯齿算法来提高游戏的图像质量。
调整伽马值。50 是普通。

About PCSX2: Selects the Video Codec to be used for Video Capture. <b>If unsure, leave it on default.<b>
关于 PCSX2: 选择用于视频捕获的视频编码器。<b>如果不确定,请将其保留为默认值。<b>

About PCSX2: Selects the Video Format to be used for Video Capture. If by chance the codec does not support the format, the first format available will be used. <b>If unsure, leave it on default.<b>
关于 PCSX2: 指定用于视频捕获的视频格式。如果碰巧编解码器不支持该格式,则将使用第一种可用格式。<b>如果不确定,请将其保留为默认值。<b>

About PCSX2: Sets the video bitrate to be used. Higher bitrates generally yield better video quality at the cost of larger resulting file sizes.
关于 PCSX2: 设置要使用的视频比特率。更高的比特率通常生成的视频质量会更高,但代价是文件变得更大。

About PCSX2:
When checked, the video capture resolution will follow the internal resolution of the running game.

Be careful when using this setting especially when you are upscaling, as higher internal resolutions (above 4x) can result in very large video capture and can cause system overload.
关于 PCSX2:
选中时,视频捕获分辨率将遵循运行游戏的内部分辨率。

使用此设置时请小心,尤其是在使用升格时,因为更高的内部分辨率(高于 4x)可能会导致捕获的视频变得非常大并可能导致系统过载。

About PCSX2:
Parameters passed to the selected video codec.
You must use '=' to separate key from value and ':' to separate two pairs from each other.
For example: "crf = 21 : preset = veryfast"
关于 PCSX2:
传递给所选视频编解码器的参数。
必须使用‘=’将键与值分开，并使用‘:’将两对分开。
例如：“CRF=21:Preset=Veryfast”

About PCSX2: Selects the Audio Codec to be used for Video Capture. <b>If unsure, leave it on default.<b>
关于 PCSX2: 选择用于视频捕获的音频编解码器。<b>如果不确定,请将其保留为默认值。<b>

About PCSX2: Sets the audio bitrate to be used.
关于 PCSX2: 设置要使用的音频位率。

About PCSX2:
Parameters passed to the selected audio codec.
You must use '=' to separate key from value and ':' to separate two pairs from each other.
For example: "compression_level = 4 : joint_stereo = 1"
关于 PCSX2:
传递给所选音频编解码器的参数。
必须使用‘=’将键与值分开，并使用‘:’将两对分开。
例如：“COMPRESSION_LEVEL=4:JOIN_STEREO=1”

About PCSX2: Change the compression algorithm used when creating a GS dump.
关于 PCSX2: 更改创建 GS 转储时使用的压缩算法。

About PCSX2: Enables API-level validation of graphics commands.
关于 PCSX2: 启用图形命令的 API 级验证。

About PCSX2: Skips synchronizing with the GS thread and host GPU for GS downloads. Can result in a large speed boost on slower systems, at the cost of many broken graphical effects. If games are broken and you have this option enabled, please disable it first.
关于 PCSX2: 跳过 GS 线程和主机 GPU 进行 GS 下载的同步。可能会在速度较慢的系统上大幅提升速度,但代价是许多损坏的图形效果。如果游戏被破坏并且您启用了此选项,请先禁用它。

About PCSX2: Forces the use of FIFO over Mailbox presentation, i.e. double buffering instead of triple buffering. Usually results in worse frame pacing.
关于 PCSX2: 强制在 Mailbox 呈现上使用FIFO,即双缓冲而不是三缓冲。通常会导致较差的帧间隔。
双线性 (强制除活动块外)

About PCSX2: PCSX2 will dump and load texture replacements from this directory.
关于 PCSX2: PCSX2 将会从此目录转储并加载纹理替换。
未缩放的调色板纹理绘制

About PCSX2: Automatically checks for updates to the program on startup. Updates can be deferred until later or skipped entirely.
关于 PCSX2: 在启动时自动检查程序的更新。更新可以推迟到以后也可以完全跳过。

About PCSX2: Prevents the screen saver from activating and the host from sleeping while emulation is running.
关于 PCSX2: 在模拟运行时防止激活屏幕保护程序以及主机休眠。

About PCSX2: Determines whether a prompt will be displayed to confirm shutting down the virtual machine when the hotkey is pressed.
关于 PCSX2: 确定按下热键时是否显示确认关闭虚拟机的提示。

About PCSX2: Pauses the emulator when a controller with bindings is disconnected.
关于 PCSX2: 当绑定的控制器断开连接时暂停模拟器。

About PCSX2: For games with both a title in the game's native language and one in English, prefer the English title. Affects how game titles are displayed on the game list, window title and Discord Presence
关于 PCSX2: 对于游戏既有本地语言标题又有英语标题的情况,优先使用英文标题。这会影响游戏列表、窗口标题和 Discord 状态中游戏标题的显示

About PCSX2: Show a save state selector UI when switching slots instead of showing a notification bubble.
关于 PCSX2: 当切换即时存档位置时显示一个即时存档选择器 UI 而不是显示一个提示气泡。

About PCSX2: Renders the game to a separate window, instead of the main window. If unchecked, the game will display over the game list.
关于 PCSX2: 将游戏渲染到单独的窗口而不是主窗口。如果未选中,游戏将显示在游戏列表之上。

About PCSX2: Hides the main window (with the game list) when a game is running. Requires Render To Separate Window to be enabled.
关于 PCSX2: 在游戏运行时隐藏主窗口(带有游戏列表)。需要开启渲染到分离窗口。

About PCSX2: Allows switching in and out of fullscreen mode by double-clicking the game window.
关于 PCSX2: 允许双击游戏窗口来切换全屏模式。

About PCSX2: Prevents the main window from being resized.
关于 PCSX2: 防止调整主窗口的大小。

About PCSX2: Automatically starts Big Picture Mode instead of the regular Qt interface when PCSX2 launches.
关于 PCSX2: 启动 PCSX2 时自动启动大屏模式,而不是常规的 Qt 界面。

About PCSX2:
Enable an animated/static background on the game list (where you launch your games).
This background is only visible in the library and will be hidden once a game is launched. It will also be paused when it's not in focus.

此背景仅在库中可见一旦启动游戏将被隐藏。当窗口未处于焦点时背景也会暂停。

About PCSX2:
By default, PCSX2 will map your keyboard to the virtual PS2 controller.

To use an external controller, you must map it first. On this screen, you can automatically map any controller which is currently connected. If your controller is not currently connected, you can plug it in now.

To change controller bindings in more detail, or use multi-tap, open the Settings menu and choose Controllers once you have completed the Setup Wizard.

Guides for configuring controllers can be found here.
关于 PCSX2:
默认情况下,PCSX2 会将您的键盘映射到虚拟 PS2 控制器上。

要使用外部控制器,您必须首先对其进行映射。在此屏幕上,您可以自动映射当前连接的任何控制器。如果您的控制器当前未连接,您现在可以将其插入。

要更详细地更改控制器绑定,或使用多分插,请在完成设置向导后打开设置菜单并选择控制器。

可以在这里找到有关如何配置控制器的指南。

About PCSX2:
Put each game's image and its security dongle in one of your game folders (see the game list settings), named after the game's ID: NM00010.chd and NM00010.ps2, for example, or both in a folder named NM00010. The image is a .chd or an unpacked .iso. The dongle is the game's memory card file, a .ps2 or .bin; a packed .bin.gz also works.

Nothing is copied except the dongle, into the memory cards folder, the first time the game starts. A game made from a PCSX2x6 template folder, with its own .acgame, works as it is.

The game list shows a game with what it still lacks, and starting one that is not ready says what to add.
关于 PCSX2:
把每个游戏的镜像及其安全 dongle 放进任一游戏文件夹（见游戏列表设置），以游戏 ID 命名：例如 NM00010.chd 和 NM00010.ps2，或把两者放在名为 NM00010 的文件夹中。镜像为 .chd 或解包的 .iso；dongle 是游戏的记忆卡文件，.ps2 或 .bin，压缩的 .bin.gz 也可以。

除 dongle 外不会复制任何内容：首次启动游戏时 dongle 会被复制进记忆卡文件夹。用 PCSX2x6 模板文件夹制作、自带 .acgame 的游戏可直接使用。

游戏列表会标出游戏还缺什么，启动未就绪的游戏时会提示需要补充的内容。

About PCSX2: The packs in the catalog are made of ASTC textures, a compressed format that phones, handhelds, Apple Silicon and Asahi GPUs read directly. Most desktop NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs cannot, and the emulator skips ASTC replacement textures on a GPU that lacks it.\n\nA pack marked with a warning still downloads and installs, but it will not change how the game looks on this GPU.
关于 PCSX2: 目录中的包由 ASTC 纹理构成，这是一种手机、掌机、Apple Silicon 和 Asahi GPU 可直接读取的压缩格式。大多数桌面 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel GPU 不支持，模拟器会在缺少该能力的 GPU 上跳过 ASTC 替换纹理。\n\n带警告标记的包仍会下载并安装，但不会改变本 GPU 上的游戏画面。
